title: ExerciseSpec
description: The exercise bundle a client sends with POST /answers/evaluate (and /query's optional exercise). It is the REQUEST shape, so it describes what the client actually sends rather than the full authored record: id, version, lesson_id, the result contract and the reference solution are the fields the gateway reads and grades with. `type`, `prompt` and `setup` are accepted for authored/fixture records that carry them, but the gateway does not grade on them and a live client does not send them.

type.description: Authored exercise kind. Accepted and carried, but not a grading input: grading compares results, never SQL text or exercise type.

prompt.description: Authored prompt. Accepted and carried, not a grading input.

setup.description: The environment an authored record runs against. Optional on a live evaluate request — the client sends `dataset` and `dialect` as siblings of `exercise` instead — but present on authored and fixture records.

dialect.description: The dialect this exercise's contract was written for. A graded answer whose dialect differs from the running engine is refused with DIALECT_MISMATCH: the values in a contract are engine-specific, so grading one engine's output against another's contract would be a silent wrong answer.

contract.description: The result contract the client actually sends. This is the key POST /answers/evaluate reads (the Go evaluator prefers it over result_contract when both are present).

result_contract.description: The authored spelling of the same contract. A fixture or an older client may send this instead of `contract`; the gateway accepts either.

reference_solution.description: The query the gateway executes to produce the oracle rows. Without it the gateway can only check column names, which made every answer pass.

solution.description: An alias for reference_solution accepted from authored records.
